name: smwmusic-piyopiyoplayer-maguman
title: PiyoPiyoPlayer - Maguman
description:
An energectic theme, made by Pixel on his spare time, in a collection of songs from PiyoPiyoPlayer. It was apparently intended to be played on Cave Story, on its early versions.

It does uses the KDL3 soundfont.

Original description by Pixel
Original:
○マグマン："洞窟物語"で使う予定だった。
Rough translation:
• Magman: I was planning to use it in "Cave Story".
